name: browser-use
headline: Pockode - Mobile AI Coding Agent Control
short_description: Pockode is a mobile interface for Claude Code, enabling remote control of local AI coding agents. Operations teams can manage AI-driven coding tasks from anywhere, integrating with existing workflows and tools. Ideal for developers and operations teams needing flexibility and mobility.
author: sijiaoh

sections.overview:
Pockode brings your home development machine to your pocket by connecting your phone to Claude Code. Chat with AI, browse files, review diffs, and manage worktrees from anywhere—on your commute, during code reviews, or while away from your desk. The tool lets developers stay productive without being physically at their workstation, supporting natural language coding, file navigation, syntax-highlighted diff viewing, and multi-project session management. Install on your dev machine, scan a QR code on your phone, and start coding remotely with your full codebase and AI assistant accessible instantly.
Fix bugs and deploy hotfixes from your commute or couch
Review code diffs while waiting or traveling
Chat with Claude Code and manage multiple project branches remotely
Maintain coding flow without returning to your desk
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/sijiaoh/pockode`
sections.usage:
```
Use Pockode to remotely execute [TASK] on my local AI coding agent. [ADDITIONAL_CONTEXT] if needed. Monitor progress and report back any errors or output.
```
